messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — blog + benchmark scheduled to go live in ~90m. Need a short press routing + rapid triage plan. @Ryan @Elaine please.
Ryan (Comms): On it. Pulling the priority reporter list now. Any embargo requirements?
Maya (Marketing): No formal embargo. Prefer to quietly alert 6 priority reporters first before broad social. Doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/bench-announce (internal)
Ryan (Comms): Got it. Draft pitch below — will DM. Please confirm wording: 'Redwood Inference releases Optimize: workshops + benchmarks for inference efficiency. Early numbers show 2-4x cost reductions.'
Elaine (Legal): Legal ok on concept but remove direct competitor references and customer names. Add line: 'No customer data was used.' Also use approved trademark phrasing for product name.
Sasha (Product): I updated the blog with the percentile graphs and a short methods appendix. If legal wants, we can swap to high-level numbers only.
Maya (Marketing): Keep the headline numbers but move low-level config details to the appendix link. Social will prefer a punchy stat.
Ryan (Comms): I'll DM the six reporters in batches. Will paste any replies here. Social scheduling will wait for my "green" to avoid mixed messaging.
press-monitor-bot: New clip monitor channel created. Tracking inbound pickups; will post any hits > 3k reach here.
Maya (Marketing): Support heads up — expect questions on latency and regional availability. @Aisha please stand by to triage customer outlets.
Aisha (Support): On standby. If anyone reports functional regressions, route to #eng-runtime and tag @eng-oncall; we have a warm runbook.
Ryan (Comms): DMs sent to 4/6 reporters, two pending. Copy of the DM I used:
> Hi {name}, heads up — we published a blog + benchmark about Optimize. Happy to send an early read or attach a short quote from an engineer.
press-monitor-bot: Incoming: TechDaily emailed for comment. Ryan to reply with hi-level link and offer a short call.
Elaine (Legal): One small thing — use the approved boilerplate text at the bottom of the post. I pasted it into the doc just now.
Maya (Marketing): :thumbsup: Plan: publish T+0, social T+15 if no major negative. After the first hour we'll do a quick readout here and escalate any big hits.
Ryan (Comms): Noted. I'll post a status update 30m after publish. If any major pickups, we'll convene the quick response call.
Maya (Marketing): Also, avoid posting code snippets in social. Keep link to appendix for technical readers.
Sasha (Product): If any reporter asks about hardware config, direct them to the appendix and offer a technical write-up instead of live numbers.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks everyone — keep replies short in this thread so we have a clean readout.
